errors.text_span: “操作”、“时间”、“疾病”、“医学”和“检查症状”
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly combines the last two categories on the x-axis, 'Examination' and 'Symptom', into a single non-existent category '检查症状' (Examination Symptom). The chart shows six distinct categories.

errors.text_span: 水平轴标签按字母顺序排列
errors.evidence: The labels on the horizontal axis (Operation, Time, Disease, Medicine, Examination, Symptom) are not in alphabetical order.
The range of the vertical axis is from 0% to 40%, not 0% to 35%.
The tick marks on the vertical axis are shown at 5% intervals, not 10% and 20%.
The bar for 'Operation' represents a value of approximately 11%. Stating it is 'exactly 12%' ('刚好占 12%') is an incorrect claim of precision.
The bar for 'Disease' represents a value of approximately 12%, which is visibly higher than the 10% line. Reporting it as 10% is a significant understatement.

errors.text_span: “医学”的柱状图达到 35% 的比例
errors.evidence: The bar for 'Medicine' is at approximately 12%. The value of 35% belongs to the 'Symptom' category. This is a major error in mapping a value to the correct category.

errors.text_span: “检查症状”的柱状图位于图中的中间位置，达到约 20% 的比例
errors.evidence: The description provides data for a hallucinated category '检查症状' (Examination Symptom) that does not exist in the chart.
The description completely omits the 'Symptom' category, which has the highest value in the chart (approx. 35%) and is the most prominent data point.
The description does not mention the title of the x-axis, which is '实体类型' (Entity Type).
